description: This is a Java interface named TaxRateDao that defines data access methods for TaxRate entities related to tax rates, including listing by store, country, zone, tax class, and retrieving by code.

classes.name: TaxRateDao
classes.description: A data access object interface for tax rate entities, providing methods to retrieve tax rates based on various criteria such as store, country, zone, tax class, and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxRate objects associated with the specified MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxRate objects filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxRate objects filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate object by its code for the specified MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxRate objects associated with the specified MerchantStore and language.
